analysis_steps.goal: Visibility-domain model fit of dust profile

method.value: Two-component analytic disk model with gaps, images converted to visibilities with vis_sample, MCMC fit, residual imaging

evidence.quote: we utilize the public python code vis_sample

key_parameters.value: 11 free parameters, flat priors, 100 walkers, 500 burn-in + 500 steps

evidence.quote: The burn-in phase (from initial conditions to reasonable sampling) employs 500 steps, and we run another 500 steps for convergence, totaling 1000 steps with 100 walkers.

assumptions.value: Inclination and P.A. fixed to ellipse-fit values

evidence.quote: The disk inclination ($i$) and position angle (P.A.) are fixed as in Table 1.
Our calculations used flat priors with the parameter ranges summarized in Table [2](#tab:table2).

validation.value: Reduced chi2 2.4; residual map shows 7 sigma west structure

evidence.quote: The residual map shows a structure at $\sim$7 $\sigma$ level to the west in the outer dust ring, indicating a real azimuthal asymmetry.

findings_qualitative.value: Inner dust ring is symmetric in continuum but 12CO is asymmetric, peaking at north blob

evidence.quote: This inner ring is symmetric in continuum emission, but asymmetric in $^{12}$CO emission.

claims.hypothesis: DM Tau has a dust cavity of a few au
claims.experiment: Long-baseline ALMA 1.3 mm imaging and visibility model fit
claims.result: Inner ring at ~4 au and cavity R_cav=3.16 au

evidence.quote: allows discovery of a 4 au radius inner dust ring, confirming previous SED modeling results

claims.hypothesis: The outer ring is azimuthally asymmetric
claims.experiment: Visibility model fit and residual map

evidence.quote: indicating a real azimuthal asymmetry

claims.hypothesis: The gap is depleted relative to the outer ring
claims.result: Factor ~40 depletion, gap not dust free

evidence.quote: substantially suppressed by a factor of $\sim$40 relative to the outer ring

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Photoevaporation disfavored by normal accretion rate; secular gravitational instability and sintering inconsistent with gap properties

evidence.quote: The measured close-to-normal accretion rate of DM Tau disfavors photoevaporation

limitations_admitted.value: Inner ring north-south asymmetry needs more data to confirm

evidence.quote: More data are needed to confirm the apparent asymmetry.
